message.content: Starting triage on the reported max_wait failure — shrinking to a minimal case.
Shrunk to a minimal failing case — now confirming it reproduces.
Replay confirmed the violation — now inspecting the failure point.
At the violating step the NS direction is green while W has waited 201s — now tracing back to see why the green never ended.
Ledger: open — detector_fail on S (same direction as heavy N demand) somehow pins NS green past max_green/recall, starving W; ruled out nothing yet. Inspecting earlier to measure green length.
This NS green has already lasted 100+ seconds — checking when it started and how it relates to the detector failure.
The detector failure starts right in the middle of this green — looking just before it to pin down the sequence.
Still green at 2140 — searching further back for the start of this phase.
This NS green has outlasted the 73s max — now running a counterfactual without the detector failure to test the cause.
No violation without the failure — confirming the green duration with a few more samples.
Ledger: open — why NS green exceeds max_green 73s while S detector failed; ruled out — scenario without failure passes. Comparing end states to confirm.
The stuck-green pattern is clear — gathering one final midpoint reading before filing the report.
